title: Finding Resistance
text: From P = V²/R, rearrange to R = V²/P = (240)²/60 = 57600/60 = 960 Ω.

title: Finding Current
text: Using P = IV, rearrange to I = P/V = 60/240 = 0.25 A = 250 mA.

title: Verify with Ohm's Law
text: Check: V = IR → 240 = (0.25)(960) = 240 V. Confirmed! Also: P = I²R = (0.25)²(960) = 0.0625 × 960 = 60 W. Confirmed!
